desc: Ignoring the double approach was almost unheard of before 2017, because usually just surrounding the black stone was thought to favor White. And surrounding Black and forcing Black to live in the corner is a textbook idea to benefit White. But at the earliest stage of a game, Black can tenuki if another point is big enough, such as pressing down a 3-4 point. See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 8, AlphaGo Master (W) vs. Han Yizhou 5p (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KVmQ15D1pHs&t=113s).
